'''Ruhr''' was a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Je'daii Temple Master]] serving the [[Je'daii Order]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] at the height of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire's]] reign.

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]], Ruhr was trained in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Je'daii Order]] on the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], one of nine planets in the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] which made up the [[Settled Worlds]]. Appointed as a [[Je'daii Temple Master]], the highest ranking members of the Order, Ruhr governed the Great Temple of the Je'daii Academy, [[Padawan Kesh]]. Ruhr and the other Temple Masters formed the [[Je'daii Council|Masters' Council]], meeting via [[Holocomm/Legends|holocommunication]] at the Temple of Balance, [[Akar Kesh]].<ref name="DotJ4" />
